user: I have a severe allergy to tree nuts.
assistant:  I'm sorry to hear that you have a severe allergy to tree nuts. It's important to take this allergy seriously, as even trace amounts of tree nuts can cause a severe allergic reaction (anaphylaxis) in some people. Here are some tips to help you manage your allergy:

1. Always read food labels carefully: Even if you have eaten a product before, always check the label to make sure it doesn't contain tree nuts or was processed in a facility that also processes tree nuts.
2. Ask about ingredients: When eating at restaurants or other people's homes, always ask about the ingredients in the food being served. Don't be afraid to ask questions and speak up if you're unsure about something.
3. Carry an epinephrine auto-injector: If you have a severe allergy to tree nuts, it's important to carry an epinephrine auto-injector with you at all times in case of an emergency.
4. Wear a medical alert bracelet: A medical alert bracelet can help alert others to your allergy in case of an emergency.
